screens.name: Version question
screens.note: Shows at a normal start while the device version is not set (new device, after an update from an older firmware, after a factory reset), and after a hold on Settings > Version. The left half is DIY, the right half is PEQ. Each half is one large button. Hold the left button = DIY. Hold the right button = PEQ. A short press does nothing. A button fills from the left while it is held (0.7 s), like the small hold buttons.

elements.note: large hold button DIY: HoldButton_drawLarge(3, 10, 54, 21, "DIY", fill)
large hold button PEQ: HoldButton_drawLarge(71, 10, 54, 21, "PEQ", fill)
